service.method: SELECT MODULE AS TREE_ID , MODULE , PARENT AS TREE_PARENT_ID , PARENT , DESCRIPTION AS TREE_VALUE , DESCRIPTION , OPTIONS , SORT , TYPE , NODE , REMARK , ALIAS , DEFAULT_OPTION_VALUE FROM SBMMA ORDER BY PARENT, SORT

SELECT PATH AS TREE_ID ,SUBSTR(PATH, 1, INSTR(PATH, '_', -1)-1) AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,CONTENTS AS TREE_VALUE ,MODULE ,PARENT ,COMBO ,CONTENTS ,DESCRIPTION ,SORT ,USE_FLAG FROM ( SELECT '*' || SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(L.SORT, '_') AS PATH ,L.MODULE ,L.PARENT ,L.COMBO ,LANG.CONTENTS ,LANG2.CONTENTS AS DESCRIPTION ,L.SORT ,CASE WHEN NVL(CMAM.MODULE, '_NOT_SELECTED_') = '_NOT_SELECTED_' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS USE_FLAG ,CMAM."OPTION" FROM ( SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,MODULE ,PARENT ,COMBO ,SORT FROM SBMMA WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' ) L JOIN SLANG LANG ON L.HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND LANG.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG2 ON L.HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND LANG2.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE_DES' AND LANG2.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG2.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMAM CMAM ON CMAM.MODULE = L.MODULE AND CMAM.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND CMAM.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} START WITH L.PARENT = '*' CONNECT BY PRIOR L.MODULE = L.PARENT ORDER SIBLINGS BY SORT )
SELECT MODULE ,OPTIONS FROM SCMAM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
